name: tableau
description: Tableau plugin for Codex with workbook authoring, visual analysis, and MCP capabilities.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze data and build or modify Tableau workbooks.
interface.longDescription: Teach Codex to analyze data, build and modify Tableau workbooks, validate workbook packages, and use the hosted Tableau MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Use Tableau to list the workbooks I have access to.
Use Tableau to query the Superstore data source for sales by region.
Use Tableau to summarize the latest Pulse metrics for revenue.
Use Tableau to create a new workbook with a bar chart of sales by region.
Use Tableau to make a copy of the Superstore workbook and add a filter for the East region.  Publish it back as new workbook.
Use Tableau to show me the Regional Sales dashboard.
